scheme_name: NEC Stipend And Book Grant Scheme
description:
The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme was launched by the North Eastern Council (NEC) in India in the year 2007. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from the northeastern states of India. 

The primary objective of the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is to promote education among students belonging to economically weaker sections. 

The scheme specifically targets students pursuing higher education in various fields. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme provides a monthly stipend to eligible students. 

The amount of the stipend is fixed at ₹2,000 per month. 

In addition to the stipend, the scheme also offers a one-time book grant. 

The book grant is provided at the rate of ₹5,000. 

This financial assistance is intended to help students cover their educational expenses. 

The scheme is applicable to students from the eight northeastern states of India. 

These states include Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, and Tripura. 

Eligibility criteria for the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme include specific academic requirements. 

Students must be enrolled in a recognized institution for higher education. 

They must be pursuing a degree or diploma course. 

The scheme is open to students from economically weaker sections. 

The annual family income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2.5 lakh. 

Students must also be residents of one of the northeastern states. 

The application process for the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested students must fill out the application form available on the official NEC website. 

They are required to submit relevant documents along with the application. 

These documents include proof of admission to a recognized institution. 

Students must also provide income certificates to verify their family income. 

A copy of the student's bank passbook is also required. 

The application form must be submitted to the respective state nodal agency. 

Each northeastern state has a designated nodal agency for this purpose. 

The nodal agencies are responsible for processing applications and disbursing funds. 

The timeline for application submission usually aligns with the academic calendar. 

Students are encouraged to apply as soon as they receive their admission confirmation. 

The disbursement of the stipend occurs on a monthly basis. 

The book grant is typically disbursed in a lump sum after the application is approved. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is implemented by the North Eastern Council. 

The NEC operates under the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region. 

The contact details for the NEC can be found on their official website. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme has seen a significant number of beneficiaries since its inception. 

In the year 2020 alone, approximately 5,000 students benefited from the scheme. 

The scheme has contributed to increasing the enrollment rates in higher education among northeastern students. 

It has played a crucial role in reducing the financial burden on families. 

The scheme also aims to enhance the quality of education in the northeastern region. 

By providing financial support, it encourages students to pursue their academic goals. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote education in the northeast. 

Other initiatives include scholarships and skill development programs. 

The NEC continuously reviews and updates the scheme to meet the needs of students. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for improvements. 

The scheme is also aligned with the government's vision of "Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas." 

This vision emphasizes inclusive growth and development for all sections of society. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is an essential tool for empowering students. 

It helps bridge the gap between educational aspirations and financial constraints. 

The scheme has a positive impact on the socio-economic development of the northeastern states. 

It fosters a culture of education and skill development among the youth. 

The NEC aims to ensure that no deserving student is left behind due to financial limitations. 

Overall, the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme represents a significant step towards educational equity. 

It reflects the commitment of the Indian government to support the youth of the northeastern region. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the changing educational landscape. 

It remains a vital resource for students seeking higher education opportunities. 

The NEC encourages all eligible students to take advantage of this scheme. 

By doing so, they can secure the financial support necessary for their educational journey. 

The NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to fostering education. 

It is a crucial initiative that empowers students to achieve their full potential. 

The scheme not only supports individual students but also contributes to the overall development of the region. 

In conclusion, the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme is a comprehensive welfare initiative. 

It provides critical financial assistance to students from the northeastern states of India. 

Through this scheme, the NEC aims to promote higher education and improve the quality of life for students. 

The scheme is a testament to the importance of education in building a prosperous future. 

Students are encouraged to apply and benefit from the opportunities provided by this scheme. 

The NEC remains committed to supporting the educational aspirations of the youth in the northeastern region.
